# Wire list (v0.3)

Every physical wire, generated from the schematic and checked against it: both ends of each run are on the same net, and every pin is reached by a wire, sits on the interface board A1, or is listed at the bottom with the reason. Label each wire at both ends with its W number (heat-shrink labels).

Lengths are not given yet: they wait on the box and under-seat measurements (#18). Gauges are minimums; a heavier wire is always fine. A1:GND, A1:3V3 and A1:5V are the bus strips on the interface board.

## Rules

- **Every fuse protects the wire after it:** the wire is rated above the fuse. 10 AWG after F1 (40 A), 14 AWG after F2 (15 A), 16 AWG after F6/F10 (10 A), 20-22 AWG after the 1-3 A fuses.
- **The only unfused copper** is battery + to F1: keep it under 15 cm and away from metal edges.
- **One ground star (TB1).** Battery −, every driver B−, the buck inputs and the A1 ground bus land there and nowhere else.
- **Run each B+ beside its B−,** and each PWM/EN pair beside a GND wire, to keep loops small.
- **Kill lines (yellow)** never share a connector pin with anything else and never get a pull-up.
- **Motor leads** are protected by F1 and by the BTS7960's own current limit; 12 AWG is rated well above one motor's current.

## Colour code

| Code | Colour | Use |
|---|---|---|
| RD | red | battery + and motor + side (10/12 AWG); 5 V rails (22 AWG) |
| RD/YE | red, yellow band | MOTOR_24V: switched by K1 |
| BK | black | ground, motor − side |
| OG | orange (or red + orange band) | key-switched 24 V branches after F2-F8, 12 V branches |
| VT | violet | 3V3_SENSE |
| YE | yellow | kill lines: DRIVE_EN, STEER_EN, CONTACTOR_HOLD |
| BU | blue | motor PWM (RPWM and LPWM) |
| GY | grey | I2C SCL |
| GN | green | I2C SDA |
| BN | brown | analog: IS sense, pedal, battery sense |
| WH | white | digital inputs, UART, 1-Wire, switch lines |
| BK/WH | black, white band | low-side switched returns (lights, fans) |
